names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Σεβαστιανός του Καραγκάντα», with the rank word left off; the page gives his name in the world as Stephen Vasilevich Fomin, in Greek letters.

The bare name out of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 9163, headed «Севастиан (Фомин) Карагандинский, схиархимандрит, исп.», with the surname, the office, the rank word and the epithet left off. The life gives his name in the world: Степан Васильевич Фомин.

The fullest form this calendar prints for him, read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 6 апреля ст. ст., name page 9163, «Севастиан (Фомин) Карагандинский, схиархимандрит, исп.», with the office word and the rank abbreviation left off and the surname kept in the brackets the calendar prints it in. The folder’s other `ru` form, the bare «Севастиан», was read off the same calendar’s 9 октября ст. ст., whose line gives the forename and the toponymic only; both are kept because both are printed. No folder holds either this form or the surname «Фомин»; `.tmp/foldchk.py` and `.tmp/rusurn.py` were both run before this upgrade.

birth.note: saint.gr: «γεννήθηκε το έτος 1884 μ.Χ. στην επαρχία Ορέλ της Ρωσίας», and the page heads him «(1884 - 1966)».

death.note: saint.gr: «κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 1966 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(1884 - 1966)».

feast.note: This day is the finding of his relics, which the day line dates to 1997 and his index page marks «(обретение мощей)». That page lists two other days: «6 апреля», his repose, and «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so both are recorded here and he does not render on either.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 9 октября ст. ст. — «Обретение мощей прп. Севастиана Карагандинского исп (1997).»
source.note: No rank is read onto him. His line closes the day's third paragraph, which carries no icon; the day's two icons are both in the first, and belong to the apostle James and to Andronicus and his wife.

attestations.note: The Russian is where this folder's substance now comes from: saint.gr had the years 1884 and 1966 and the Orel province, and the Russian life has the whole of the rest. It also gives the office the Greek page does not, «схиархимандрит», and the mark «исп.», confessor, which the Greek page's own title for him, «Преподобноисповедник», says in one word.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Σεβαστιανός του Καραγκάντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole body of the page is four sentences, and every fact in this folder is one of them: his name in the world, Stephen Vasilevich Fomin; his birth in 1884 in the province of Oryol; his entry into Optina in 1906 and his tonsure there with the name Sebastian; his ordination deacon in 1923 and presbyter in 1927; his ministry in the Karaganda region of Kazakhstan; and his peaceful repose in 1966. It names no elder of Optina, nothing of the years between 1927 and his coming to Karaganda, no relic, and no hymn. The corpus's other Sebastian is the Roman of the Diocletianic persecution and is not this man.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

hymns.text: Троицы Святыя служителю,/ земне ангеле и небесне человече,/ духовнаго Оптинскаго старчества преемниче,/ Христов священнотаинниче и исповедниче,/ Духа Святаго обитель всечестная,/ преподобне отче Севастиане, досточтиме,/ испроси мирови мир/ и душам нашим велию милость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), страница имени 9163 — «Тропарь священноисповедника схиархимандрита Севастиана Карагандинского»
source.note: The one hymn the page prints for him, and it names him and the Optina eldership he came out of, so it is his own and not a common.

english.text: Servant of the Holy Trinity, earthly angel and heavenly man, heir of the spiritual eldership of Optina, priest of Christ's mysteries and confessor, all-honoured dwelling of the Holy Spirit, venerable and worthily honoured father Sebastian: ask peace for the world and great mercy for our souls.
